title: Market Volatility Is Back — Here’s How to Profit in 15 Minutes
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat host Bridget interviews Kareem and Brian of Monument Traders Alliance on profiting from rising volatility with two paired strategies. Brian (short-term, technicals) runs a 'dark ticker' trade: if IWM, GLD or QQQ closes down 1% or more, buy calls in the 4:00-4:15pm ET window after the close, hold 1-2 days and sell on the next-day rebound — IWM CONDITIONAL_BUY, QQQ CONDITIONAL_BUY, GLD also traded this way. Kareem (longer-term, fundamentals) argues gold is a hedge against US debt over $40T and currency debasement: GLD BUY reiterated (keep buying, dollar-cost average), AEM BUY (Agnico Eagle, premier miner, margins expand as gold rises), and NUV BUY (Nuveen muni closed-end fund, 4.73% tax-free, 6.14% taxable-equivalent at 30%, buy at current levels near its 52-week low and keep adding). Suggested split for a hands-off investor: about 90% in safer appreciating assets and 10% in the short-term trading strategy. No stance flips; GLD was already BUY on 2026-10-06, the other four are first tracked MarketBeat calls.
